inputs.text: [excited] It was 6 meters long — [quickly] as long as a road is wide — it takes up the whole street! Standing up, it was 2 meters tall — as tall as a front door! And it weighed 440 kilos — [proud] as heavy as 2 lions. [amazed] And scientists think it could run up to 31 miles an hour — as fast as a car in the city.
[proud] Yes, with those long, thin legs. [amazed] One of the fastest dinosaurs we know of.
